text:
sam: Heads up - NA telemetry backfill rbk-na-2026-03-19-07 stalled with repeating "stalled->queued" and 0 token consumption. Workers healthy but no progress.

jess: I saw the same pattern on console. Job thought it was running (green) but per-pool tokens were flat.

omar: looking at job logs: workers returned tasks with LeaseRenew error: `rpc error: code=Unavailable`. Lease-service had a short blip ~00:52 UTC.

sam: why does a ~90s lease outage translate to hours of queue churn?

omar: scheduler applies exponential backoff on requeue. When LeaseRenew fails, task is requeued with backoff and an old deadline, preventing immediate re-lease. If many tasks hit that window, the queue stalls.

claire: UX implication: job page shows running but actually stalled. We should surface lease health and last-renew timestamp on the job details.

ux: agreed - a small banner: "Lease renewals failing; progress may be delayed" would help oncall.

jess: mitigation idea: worker soft-leeway - treat LeaseRenew transient failures as soft for 30s and continue local work to avoid requeue churn for short blips.

omar: also propose scheduler reset backoff when the lease cluster reports recovered. For now we can clear backoff on affected jobs.

sam: ops: can we safely clear backoff for tagged telemetry backfills?

omar: safe path: use `/admin/jobs/{id}/retry` with `force=true` for a canary set of 20 jobs. That respects audit hooks.

infra-bot: Lease-service blip 00:51:42 UTC -> 00:53:10 UTC. Incident LEASE-2026-162 created and closed.

jess: canary started - 20 jobs retried. Monitoring.

(6m)

jess: canary success: 18/20 resumed, 2 went to DLQ due to unrelated job error. No worker thrash.

sam: good. We'll clear backoff in waves (0.4x) for remaining queued backfills. Also implement the longer-term fixes: 1) soft lease leeway 30s 2) scheduler backoff reset on global lease recovery 3) console lease-health banner 4) an admin bulk-clear endpoint with dry-run and RBAC.

omar: I'll open PRs for scheduler and worker tolerance. claire/ux can do the banner. jess will run the bulk operation.

claire: banner PR #4971 - shows lease-health, last renew time, and link to lease incident.

jess: running bulk clear now at 0.4x. Will post audit link.

sam: creating INC-2026-165 and a short postmortem once done.

omar: note for long-term: make retry kinds explicit in job API (TRANSIENT vs PERMANENT) so scheduler logic isn't implicit.

ux: small UX request: when admin retries a job show a subtle admin badge on the job timeline so auditors can see it.

infra-bot: Bulk retry audit recorded: https://internal/audit/5443210000-retry-bulk

jess: all queued backfills cleared and progressing. Monitoring for 2h.

sam: thanks all. Closing thread - will follow up with postmortem link. :white_check_mark:
